main.description: Public text search over indexed Certified profiles. Authentication is not required. search is trimmed and matched as a case-insensitive literal substring in displayName or description; blank-after-trim search imposes no text restriction, though listProfiles is preferred for unrestricted listing. actors uses repeated unbracketed keys, accepts at most 100 supplied DIDs before deduplication, and ORs them together; actor and search filters combine with AND before pagination. The handler applies limit=25 and sortDirection=desc when omitted; limit is 1..100. Results sort by a valid zoned createdAt, otherwise indexedAt (or stored row creation time when indexedAt is absent), then URI, both in the requested direction. The opaque cursor is direction-bound and provides no snapshot guarantee; keep other parameters unchanged between pages. Unknown parameters and repeated scalar keys are rejected.

search.description: Required search text; after trimming, matched case-insensitively as a literal substring in displayName or description. Blank is unrestricted.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction; handler default is desc.

actors.description: DIDs whose indexed profiles may be returned. Repeated values are ORed; handles are not resolved.

cursor.description: Opaque versioned keyset cursor bound to sortDirection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A parameter is invalid, repeated where scalar, or unknown.

errors.name: ProfileQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profiles could not be queried.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when pagination is complete.
